Package index

Connecting to UBI

The client every object sends its requests through, and the settings it reads.

UnifiedBrokerInterface
A connection to the Unified Broker Interface REST API
Configuration
The settings for one R session, read from the environment on first use

Instruments

What every instrument can do: identity, candles, quotes, the order book, orders and positions.

Derivative
A futures or option contract, which expires on a set day and is written on an underlying instrument
Futures
A futures contract, an agreement to buy or sell the underlying at a set price on the expiry date
IndexFutures
A futures contract on an index, which settles in cash because an index cannot be delivered
IndexOption
An option on an index, which settles in cash because an index cannot be delivered
Instrument
One instrument in UBI's unified instrument universe
InstrumentCatalogue
Discovery of instruments in UBI's catalogue
NonTradeableInstrument
An instrument that cannot be traded directly, which is an index
Option
An option contract, the right but not the obligation to buy the underlying at the strike price, for a call, or to sell it, for a put
TradeableInstrument
An instrument that can be traded, which is anything except an index

Equities

Shares, equity indices and their futures and options.

Equity
One listed share, such as RELIANCE on the nse
EquityFutures
One futures contract on a share, such as RELIANCE expiring in September
EquityIndex
One equity index, such as NIFTY on the nse, which is followed rather than traded
EquityIndexFutures
One futures contract on an equity index, such as NIFTY expiring in September
EquityIndexOption
One option on an equity index, such as a NIFTY call at a given strike and expiry
EquityOption
One option on a share, such as a RELIANCE call at a given strike and expiry

Fixed income

Bonds, government securities and their derivatives.

FixedIncome
One listed fixed income security, such as a government bond or a treasury bill on the nse
FixedIncomeFutures
One futures contract on a bond, such as 633GS2035 expiring in September
FixedIncomeIndex
One fixed income index, such as ONMIBOR on the nse, which is followed rather than traded
FixedIncomeIndexFutures
One futures contract on a fixed income index, such as ONMIBOR expiring in September
FixedIncomeIndexOption
One option on a fixed income index, which UBI carries none of yet
FixedIncomeOption
One option on a bond, such as a 633GS2035 call at a given strike and expiry

Commodities

Commodities, commodity indices and their derivatives.

Commodity
One commodity the exchange publishes as an underlying, such as GOLD on the mcx
CommodityFutures
One futures contract on a commodity, such as GOLD expiring in October
CommodityIndex
One commodity index, such as MCXBULLDEX on the mcx, which is followed rather than traded
CommodityIndexFutures
One futures contract on a commodity index, such as MCXBULLDEX expiring in October
CommodityIndexOption
One option on a commodity index, such as an MCXBULLDEX call at a given strike and expiry
CommodityOption
One option on a commodity, such as a GOLD call at a given strike and expiry

Currencies

Currency pairs, currency indices and their derivatives.

Currency
One currency pair the exchange publishes as an underlying, such as USDINR on the nse
CurrencyFutures
One futures contract on a currency pair, such as USDINR expiring in September
CurrencyIndex
One currency index, which UBI carries none of yet
CurrencyIndexFutures
One futures contract on a currency index, which UBI carries none of yet
CurrencyIndexOption
One option on a currency index, which UBI carries none of yet
CurrencyOption
One option on a currency pair, such as a USDINR call at a given strike and expiry

Funds and mutual funds

Exchange traded funds, investment trusts and mutual funds.

ExchangeTradedFund
One exchange-traded fund, such as NIFTYBEES on the nse
InvestmentTrust
One listed investment trust, such as the real estate trust EMBASSY on the nse
MutualFund
One mutual fund scheme, such as ABSLFTTIDG on the nse

Option pricing

Black-Scholes and Black-76 prices, greeks and implied volatility.

Black76
One European option on a forward price, such as an option priced off a future, priced by the Black-76 model
BlackScholes
One European option priced by the Black-Scholes model without dividends
OptionPricingModel
The mechanism every pricing model here shares: the normal distribution and the search for an implied volatility

Analysis

The analysis classes every instrument and basket inherits, in inheritance order.

CandlestickPatterns
Candlestick pattern recognisers an instrument runs over its candles
CycleIndicators
Hilbert transform cycle indicators an instrument calculates from its candles
MathOperators
Arithmetic and rolling extremes an instrument calculates from its candle columns
MathTransforms
Element-by-element mathematical functions an instrument applies to one candle column
MomentumIndicators
Oscillators and directional indicators an instrument calculates from its candles
OverlapStudies
Moving averages, Bollinger bands and other indicators an instrument draws over its candles
PerformanceMeasures
Return, risk and benchmark-relative measures calculated from closing prices
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_DAY_INTERVAL
The interval name of daily candles
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_HISTORICAL_METHOD
The value at risk method that reads the loss from past returns
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_MINUTE_INTERVAL_PATTERN
The pattern a minute interval such as 5minute matches
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_PARAMETRIC_METHOD
The value at risk method that assumes normally distributed returns
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_TRADING_DAYS_PER_YEAR
The number of trading days in a year, used to annualise day candles
PERFORMANCE_MEASURES_TRADING_MINUTES_PER_DAY
The number of minutes in one NSE session, from 09:15 to 15:30
PriceAnalysis
A source of candles that analysis methods can be written against
PriceStatistics
Summary statistics of the prices, volumes and returns in an instrument's candles
PriceTransforms
Per-candle price summaries an instrument calculates from its candles
Signals
Crossover and crossunder detection between two columns of a frame
StatisticFunctions
Rolling statistics an instrument calculates from its candles with TA-Lib
StrategyBacktests
Backtests of trading strategies over an instrument's candles
VolatilityIndicators
Range-based volatility indicators an instrument calculates from its candles
VolumeIndicators
Indicators an instrument calculates from its candles' prices and volumes

Backtesting engine

The R counterpart of the Python backtesting package that StrategyBacktests runs on.

Backtest
One backtest of a strategy over a table of candles
BacktestBroker
The simulated broker of a backtest
BacktestOrder
One order waiting in a backtest's order queue
BacktestPlot
A standalone HTML page showing one backtest
BacktestPosition
The sum of a backtest's open trades
BacktestStatistics
The statistics table of a finished backtest
BACKTESTING_FULL_EQUITY
The default order size, all of the available margin, which is the largest fraction below 1
BacktestStrategy
A trading strategy to run through a backtest
BacktestTrade
One trade opened by a filled order in a backtest

Synthetic orders

Order types that UBI’s order engine works on your behalf.

AccountConditionalOrder
An order sent, or cancelled, when the account's free margin, day's profit or open position count reaches a level
AccumulationOrder
A fixed quantity bought at a fixed interval, each purchase resting on its own side of the book
AttachedHedgeOrder
An entry whose fills are hedged in another instrument as they happen, by a ratio or by an option's delta
AverageTrueRangeTrailOrder
A trailing stop whose distance is a multiple of the recent average true range
BasketOrder
Orders on several instruments placed in one request, each reported on its own
BracketOrder
An entry that arms a stop and a target behind itself on its first fill, even a partial one
CandleCloseStopOrder
A hidden stop that fires only when a whole bar closes past the level
ChaserOrder
A limit order that starts on its own side of the book and steps towards the other until it fills
CloseOnTriggerOrder
A level that, when reached, cancels every order on the instrument to free margin and then closes the whole position
ClosingPriceOrder
An order sliced by volume through the half hour the day's closing price is computed from
CoverOrder
An entry with a compulsory stop and no target
CrossInstrumentOrder
A limit-if-touched order whose trigger watches the last traded price of a different instrument
DailyStopOrder
A native stop placed afresh every morning for a position held overnight
DiscretionaryOrder
A limit order that shows one price and quietly takes a slightly worse one when it comes within reach
ExposureHedgeOrder
A standing instruction to trade one hedge instrument whenever the watched instruments' net exposure leaves a band
ExposureWatch
One watched instrument and how much exposure each unit of its position carries
FreezeSlicerOrder
An order above the exchange's freeze quantity, split into even orders that each fit
GoodTillTimeOrder
An order placed now whose unfilled part is cancelled at a time of day
GoodTillTriggeredOrder
A limit-if-touched order that keeps waiting across days until it fires or expires
GridOrder
Resting buys below the market and sells above it, where each fill places its opposite one step away
HiddenStopOrder
A stop kept inside UBI that watches the bid or the offer, with an optional real stop behind it
IcebergOrder
An order that rests one slice at a time and places the next when that slice fills
ImplementationShortfallOrder
A time-sliced order whose slices shrink, so most of it trades early
IndicatorTriggeredOrder
An order sent as a limit when one field of the live quote crosses a level
LadderOrder
Several limit orders spaced evenly between two prices, sharing the quantity between them
LeggedSpreadOrder
A two-legged spread worked passively on the first leg and completed on the second at the price that makes the net
LimitIfTouchedOrder
An order that waits for the price to touch a level and then rests a limit at another price
LiquiditySeekingOrder
An order that shows nothing and strikes only when enough size appears at an acceptable price
MarketableLimitOrder
A market order sent as a limit that follows the other side of the book until it fills
MarketIfTouchedOrder
An order that waits unseen for the price to touch a level and then takes what is there
OneCancelsAllOrder
Several candidate entries, each on its own instrument, where the first fill cancels all the rest
OneCancelsOtherOrder
A stop and a target resting together on a position already held, each shrinking as the other fills
OneTriggersOtherOrder
An order that places a second, described in advance, once the first one fills
OpeningAuctionOrder
An order placed during the pre-open session, so it fills at the price the opening call auction discovers
OrderCandidate
One instrument's order inside a multi-instrument synthetic order, with the template fields it overrides
ParticipationOrder
An order that trades a fixed share of the volume the market itself trades
PegOrder
A limit order kept re-priced to the bid, the offer or the midpoint as the book moves
PostOnlyOrder
A limit order checked to rest rather than trade before it is sent
ScaleOutOrder
A bracket with several targets that take the position off in tranches, and a stop that moves to breakeven
ScaleWithProfitTakerOrder
A ladder whose every filled rung gets its own profit-taker, and is placed again once that profit is taken
ScheduledOrder
An order held until a time of day and then placed
SimpleOrder
One plain order sent to one broker, with nothing watching it afterwards
SquareOffOrder
The day's positions on one product, closed with limit orders at a time of day after their resting orders are cancelled
SteppedStopOrder
A native stop moved to set levels at set profits, and switched to trailing at the last
StopAndReverseOrder
A level that, when reached, closes the position and opens the same size the other way
StrategyStopOrder
A basket whose every leg is closed when the whole strategy's profit or loss crosses a line
SyntheticOrder
One order for UBI's order engine: an order template and the synthetic type that works it
TimeStopOrder
An entry placed now whose filled part is closed at a time of day, or after some minutes
TimeWeightedAveragePriceOrder
A large order sent as equal slices at even intervals over a period
TrailingEntryOrder
A stop entry that follows a falling market down, so the first bounce of the trailing distance fills it
TrailingStopOrder
A real stop at the broker whose trigger follows the market up, never down
TwoSidedBreakoutOrder
A buy stop above a range and a sell stop below it, where the first to fire cancels the other
TwoSidedQuoteOrder
A bid and an offer kept around the fair price, leaning away from the inventory they build
UnderlyingPegOrder
A resting limit whose price moves by delta times another instrument's move, such as an option bid following the index
VirtualLimitOrder
A limit order held inside UBI and sent only when the other side of the book reaches its price
VolatilityOrder
An option order stated as an implied volatility, priced with the Black-76 model and re-priced as the underlying and time move
VolumeWeightedAveragePriceOrder
A time-sliced order whose slice sizes follow the shape of the day's volume

Plan orders

An order described as a plan of parts.

PlanOrder
An order described as a tree of parts, which can combine the other synthetic order types

Plan parts

The parts a plan is built from: structure, pricing, quantity, execution, triggers, guards and lifetimes.

AccountCondition
A condition that holds when a figure from the account is at or past a level
AllAtOnceExecution
An execution that sends the order's whole quantity as one broker order, which is UBI's default
AllConditions
A group of trigger conditions that must all hold
AnyCondition
A group of trigger conditions of which any one is enough
BookDepthExecution
An execution that waits for enough displayed size at or inside a price and then strikes
CandleCloses
A condition that holds when a bar UBI builds from its own ticks closes past a level
CapModifier
A bound on the price a pricing rule may set
ChasePricing
A pricing rule that steps a limit from its own side of the book towards the other side
DailyExecution
An execution that sends the order again at a set time each trading day until anything trades
DiscretionModifier
A modifier that lets a resting limit take a price up to points worse than the one it shows
EitherPart
Several plans run at once, joined by what a fill on one does to the others
FixedPricing
A pricing rule that sends the order at a set price, or at market
FollowInstrumentPricing
A pricing rule that moves a resting limit after another instrument
FreezeLimitExecution
An execution that splits an order larger than the chosen broker's freeze quantity into equal orders sent together
FromFillPricing
A pricing rule for an exit set a distance from the fill that opened its position
FromParentFillPricing
A pricing rule for a spread's second leg, priced from the first leg's fill to reach a net price
FrontLoadedExecution
An execution that sends slices on a clock, each a fixed share smaller than the one before
IcebergExecution
An execution that shows a small piece of the order at a time and sends the next once it has filled
LadderExecution
An execution that sends the order as several limit orders at evenly spaced prices, all at once
Lifetime
When an order of a plan stops working, and what is done with it then
LimitMarketable
A condition that holds once the order's own limit price would fill at once
MarketablePricing
A pricing rule that sends a limit a few ticks past the opposite touch
NativeStopPricing
A pricing rule that sends a stop-limit order to rest at the broker
OptionModelPricing
A pricing rule that prices an option from an implied volatility and its underlying
OrderPart
One order of a plan, with the presets and slot values that shape it
PaperVenue
Paper trading, where an order is filled from the queue estimate and nothing reaches a broker
ParentFillDeltaQuantity
A quantity that is what an option entry filled times that option's delta
ParentFillQuantity
A quantity that is a ratio of what the first plan of a then join has filled
ParticipationExecution
An execution that sends a share of the market's traded volume on each tick
PegPricing
A pricing rule that keeps a limit at its reference in the book
PlanPart
One piece of a plan order, which can describe itself as the object UBI's order engine reads
PositionQuantity
A quantity that is the position held when the order fires, on one product and one or more instruments
PostOnlyGuard
A guard that keeps an order's limit from crossing the book
PreOpenVenue
The pre-open session, with the time the order is sent into it
Preset
One named preset and its settings
PriceCrosses
A condition that holds once a price reaches a level from the side that fires
RepeatPart
One order sent a number of times, spaced by minutes or by trading days
SequencePart
Several plans run one after another, each starting once the one before is done
StageRule
One milestone of a stepped stop, an entry of the rules list of StagesPricing
StagesPricing
A pricing rule that rests a stop-limit at the broker and steps it through profit milestones
ThenPart
A first plan and the child plan it starts when it fills
TimeAfter
A condition that holds from a time of day onwards
TimeAt
A condition that holds from a time of day onwards
TimeBefore
A condition that holds until a time of day
TimeFrom
A condition that holds from a time of day onwards, and at once when that time has already passed today
TogetherPart
Several plans started at once, each trading its own quantity
TopUpExecution
An execution that sends one new broker order each time a join raises the order's target
TrailPricing
A pricing rule that rests a stop-limit at the broker and trails it behind the market
Trails
A condition that holds once the last price has pulled back from its best by a distance
TwapExecution
An execution that sends equal slices at even intervals
UsingPart
An order whose execution's pieces each become a whole plan with the same extra presets and slot values
VwapExecution
An execution that sends slices on a clock, each sized by the volume profile of the half hour it falls in

Asset baskets

Portfolios, watchlists, indices and fund constituents, stored in MongoDB.

AssetBasket
A named group of instruments that is priced, analysed and stored as one
BasketCsvImporter
A reader of CSV files into stored baskets
BasketMember
One instrument held in a basket
BasketStore
The collection of baskets kept in the project's MongoDB
ExchangeTradedFundConstituents
The instruments an exchange traded fund holds, with their weights
Index
A weighted basket of instruments that is followed as one level
MemberResolver
A builder of basket members from rows that name their instruments
MutualFundConstituents
The instruments a mutual fund holds, with their weights
Portfolio
A basket of instruments held in known quantities
Watchlist
A group of instruments followed together, each counting equally

The account

Account-wide reads and the flatten operation.

Account
The trading account UBI trades for, across every broker it is connected to

Errors

The condition classes, which keep the Python exception names and hierarchy.

ASSET_BASKETS_ERROR_PARENTS
The errors the asset basket classes signal
ASSETS_ERROR_PARENTS
The errors the instrument classes signal
UNIFIED_BROKER_INTERFACE_ERROR_FOR_STATUS_CODE
The error class UBI's client signals for each failing HTTP status code
UNIFIED_BROKER_INTERFACE_ERROR_PARENTS
The errors the Unified Broker Interface client signals
ErrorCatalogue
The catalogue of every error class the package signals
UTILITIES_LANGUAGE_ERROR_PARENTS
The errors that stand in for Python's built-in exceptions

Utilities

Turning UBI’s answers into data frames and dates.

FrameBuilder
A converter between UBI's rows and R data frames
TimeConverter
A converter between UBI's date and time text and R's date and time types
